packageRules.description: Keep GitHub Actions pinned to immutable commits
Group platform Helm chart bumps into one PR per chart
Pin digests off — these are versioned Helm charts, not images

Wrapper charts that pin a Harbor image: Renovate cannot bump the image (the registry is unreachable from GitHub runners), so the chart-image-parity contract fails the PR until the pin moves in the same change. The label marks the required companion edit.
